segments.oily: One reviewer with oily/normal skin says it gives a glow during the day without adding extra oiliness, and another with oily combo skin calls it a favorite though it feels sticky before drying down.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin repeatedly report relief from dryness, rough or dry patches, and stinging, especially in winter, though one with very dry skin found hydration only mild and one found it not hydrating at all and peeling.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily-combo skin names this her favorite HA serum despite temporary stickiness while drying.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including sensitive mature skin, report good hydration, calmed redness and irritation, and no fragrance or stinging, though this same group also reports the product can sting on freshly picked or irritated skin.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their 40s note plumping, softer skin, reduced fine lines, and a younger-looking, hydrated face.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using it for fine lines and wrinkles report plumper, smoother skin and a younger look after daily use.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority describe visible, lasting hydration and plumpness, sometimes within days; a small minority found it barely hydrating or even dehydrating and requiring extra moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with dry, sensitive, irritated skin reports redness and irritation improving after a few days of use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with rebuilding her skin barrier after repeated chemical peels; no negative barrier reports appear.
concerns.spots: Users battling cystic or hormonal acne report visibly fewer or faster-healing breakouts and eczema calming, with one noting a mild stinging on freshly popped pimples.
concerns.blemishes: Several acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and faster healing; conversely two reviewers state it caused new or worsening breakouts, including one describing her worst acne in 15+ years.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer says it helped tighten and clear her pores and left skin feeling less oily; another with oily/normal skin says it did not increase oiliness.

aspects.libelle: Sticky or tacky residue before drying
Low price for size and quality
Causes peeling or dehydration for some
